description: Shift the amount boundary so a zero-amount transfer is allowed
expected_violation: A zero transfer amount is accepted instead of rejected
violation_scenario: transfer_funds(BankAccount(id='b1', balance=100.0), BankAccount(id='b2', balance=20.0), 0.0) completes without raising.
rationale: Moving the boundary from <= 0 to < 0 admits a zero amount, the smallest shift that violates the strictly-positive rule while positive-amount tests still pass.
